mod.name: Creatures' Hidden Potential
mod.description: Mod adding various bonuses for creatures, to make use of their unused animations, with as slight impact to game's balance as possible
mod.alternative shooting centaur.name: Alternative shooting Centaurs
mod.alternative shooting centaur.descrip: A mod adding shooting ability to centaurs, but no arrows. They need ammo cart to shoot.
mod.enraged minotaur.name: Enraged Minotaurs
mod.enraged minotaur.description: A mod adding enchanting ability to Minotaur Kings (casting Frenzy when the battle starts), but only if they have no morale.
mod.furious cyclops.name: Furious Cyclopes
mod.furious cyclops.description: A mod changing the way Cyclopes behave when they get blinded (they're not happy).
mod.karmic harpies.name: Karmic Harpies
mod.karmic harpies.description: A mod allowing Harpy Hags to cast a lethal curse on one of their foes - the creatures they attack will have a chance to deal double damage on retaliation.
mod.siege dendroids.name: Siege Dendroids
mod.siege dendroids.description: A mod adding enchanting ability to Dendroid Soldiers. Using powerful roots of Rampart woods, they'll bind enemy Catapult for the first turn.
mod.teleporting elemental.name: Teleporting Elementals
mod.teleporting elemental.description: A mod that changes Energy Elementals movement to teleport.
